## Activity

Capture activity at North City Eye Clinic during January 2026 totalled 523 captures. This level of activity provides the basis for reviewing image quality and grading performance for the reporting period. The service should continue to monitor activity routinely and ensure that operational information is recorded consistently. Any issues affecting the capture process should be identified promptly and followed through the appropriate support arrangements.

## Image quality

There were 13 ungradable captures, representing an ungradable rate of 2.5 per cent. The clinic should continue to review image quality issues as part of routine operational monitoring. The clinic lead asks that recurring camera issues are logged with the service desk so that potential equipment or process problems can be tracked and addressed.

## Grading

A total of 136 results were graded referable during January 2026. The median grading wait was 2 days. These results should continue to be reviewed alongside capture activity and image quality, with any recurring delays or quality concerns raised through the usual operational channels. This will support timely follow-up and help maintain consistent service performance.
